name: Theodorus Bailey
bioAdditions: Pelletreau's Bailey page (S1) gives his line: Bull Smith -> Richard 2d -> Richard 3d (b. 16 Apr 1696) -> Phebe (b. 19 Aug 1743, m. 10 Nov 1776 Nathaniel Platt, a founder of Plattsburgh) -> Phebe (m. Judge William Bailey of Plattsburgh) -> Theodorus: 4th cousin 7 times removed. His wife Sarah Ann Platt was also a cousin, closer through Job Smith (Job 1st -> Job 2d -> Anna -> Richard 4th -> Dorothy (m. Isaac S. Platt) -> Sarah Ann: 4C6R), so their children descend from Bull Smith by several lines, as Pelletreau's five descent tables show.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Path stated in Pelletreau with dated generations.
